summary: Tested Twin MPFM Bacalhau backend (16 pytest tests) and frontend (all 8 navigation routes, KPIs, Consultor evaluate flow, comparisons, calibration, PVT CRUD modal, memorial drawer + page, envelope, theme toggle). 100% backend pass rate. All UI flows functional and integrations working. Seed creates 4 PVT samples + 120 windows; dashboard summary, IAJ, K-factors, comparisons (4 pairs), memorial markdown, xlsx import all verified end-to-end.

issues: Scatter points have very low contrast in dark mode — chart area appears nearly empty. Consider lighter/brighter point fill colors for dark theme.

React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' in select-window dropdown (Consultor.js ~line 131). Caused by visual-editor wrapper inserting a <span> inside <option>. Functionally OK but produces console error on every render. Workaround: render plain string text inside <option> (not an expression that gets wrapped) or memoize option labels.

Recharts warning: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. ResponsiveContainer parents should set explicit min-height (e.g. h-72) or pass aspect ratio to avoid transient zero-size renders.

action_items: Optional: improve dark-mode contrast for scatter points on Envelope chart (and Dashboard envelope panel).
Optional: silence hydration warning on Consultor select-window by simplifying <option> children (use template literal as single text child without wrapping spans).
Optional: add min-height to recharts ResponsiveContainer wrappers to eliminate width(-1)/height(-1) warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~880 lines and mixes models, calc engines, memorial builder, routes and seed — consider splitting into modules (models.py, services/calculations.py, services/memorial.py, routes/*.py) once it grows past Phase 1.
evaluate_window is invoked from seed() in a tight loop (120 calls); fine for MVP but consider batching/async gather for performance.

Import endpoint trusts column-name presence; rejected counter increments on any exception but there's no validation feedback per-row returned to the UI. Consider returning a sample of rejection reasons.
kw_blocked logic compares test water vs total mass with 1% threshold — solid heuristic, but document the rule in PRD/code comment.
All MongoDB queries correctly exclude _id with projection — good. clean_doc helper also defensive.
Frontend api.js (not opened in detail) reportedly uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — confirmed by working integrations.
Memorial endpoint returns text/plain via PlainTextResponse and contains all 10 required sections — verified.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed seeds 4 PVT + 120 windows and evaluates all of them. Triggered via both backend test fixture and UI seed-button.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers root, dashboard summary, windows list/filter/get/404, consultor evaluate (full schema), memorial markdown sections, PVT CRUD, all 4 comparison pairs, K-factors, and xlsx import. Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Seed is invoked at session scope. Frontend uses data-testid extensively — all selectors documented in review_request work as-is.
